$pid.// note: Clients authenticate to RTDB with a per-project Firebase custom token minted by /api/realtime/token, carrying claims { pid, canEdit }. The channel is a single ephemeral broadcast log: each entry is a {topic, origin, ts, payload} envelope, delivered once to connected peers and then removed. canEdit gates publishing edits (doc/playback/sync); view-only holders may still publish ephemeral 'presence' and 'cursor' topics so the live-peers indicator and live cursors work (mirrors the old Ably publish-vs-subscribe split).

$msgId..write: auth != null && auth.token.pid === $pid && (!newData.exists() || auth.token.canEdit === true || newData.child('topic').val() === 'presence' || newData.child('topic').val() === 'cursor')
